name: security-headers
description: Strict nonce-based Content-Security-Policy upgrade for the baseline headers shipped in the template
instructions: Baseline headers (nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, HSTS, frame-ancestors) are already applied by next.config.ts via src/config/security.ts.
This module adds the STRICT nonce-based CSP. It forces dynamic rendering on the pages it covers — read the comments in src/lib/csp.ts before adopting it.
After wiring the nonce into proxy.ts, remove the Content-Security-Policy entry from src/config/security.ts so the static header does not shadow it.
